stem: Which statement about being outdoors describes BOTH the article "Alone in Nature" and the poem "Wisdom in Wishes"?

options.label: A
options.text: Living outdoors can teach a person how to protect the environment.

options.label: B
options.text: People can learn important survival skills when staying outdoors.

options.label: C
options.text: Spending time outdoors can help a person build creativity.

options.label: D
options.text: People can change their minds about how much they like the outdoors.
